audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra peace/well-being offering text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for sacrifice of peace/well-being, herd/flock/goat options, fat portions, blood/life, and fat/blood prohibition.

verses.restored: If his offering is sacrifice of peace/well-being, if from herd he brings near, whether male or female, complete one he shall bring near before YHWH.

familiar.text: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.

verses.restored: He shall lay his hand on head of his offering and slaughter it at entrance of tent of meeting; sons of Aaron, the priests, shall throw blood/life against altar all around.

familiar.text: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

verses.restored: He shall bring near from sacrifice of peace/well-being a fire-offering to YHWH: fat covering inward parts and all fat upon inward parts,

familiar.text: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

verses.restored: two kidneys and fat on them that is by loins, and lobe upon liver; with kidneys he shall remove it.

familiar.text: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

verses.restored: Sons of Aaron shall turn it into smoke on altar upon burnt offering that is on wood on fire; fire-offering, soothing scent to YHWH.

familiar.text: And Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

verses.restored: Age-long statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings: all fat and all blood/life you shall not eat.

familiar.text: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.

translation_notes: Shelamim is peace/well-being/wholeness offering, likely shared meal logic in broader context.
Male or female animals may be brought for this offering, unlike some other categories.
Fat portions belong to YHWH in this ritual grammar; blood/life is not eaten.
Blood/life prohibition should be read as reverence for life, not disgust toward bodies.
safety_note: Do not turn fat/blood prohibitions into body-shame. In this ritual system, fat and blood/life are reserved to YHWH as symbols of abundance and life.
